# TG Downloader

> Browser-based website with Chrome extension assisted sign-in for Credits billing, check-in rewards, and account management.

## Core Product

- [TG Downloader Home](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/): Main website entry with account, Credits, and extension sign-in workflows.
- [Pricing](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/pricing/): Buy one-time Credits or upgrade to Unlimited monthly access.
- [Full content index](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/llms-full.txt): Complete AI-readable page index including language entrances, plans, and updates.

## Updates

- [Changelog](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/changelog/): Release notes and product updates.
- [Sitemap](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap index for canonical pages and per-language sitemap files.

## Key Facts

- Platform type: Browser website plus Chrome extension assisted workflows.
- Default language: English.
- Language coverage: 14 website locales.
